name: Ookura Resona
source:
Hometown: Tokyo, Japan

[url=/c9491]Aeon[/url]'s full sister and [url=/c9481]Yuusei[/url]'s half-sister. A hikikomori and an avid gamer. 

She has an intense love for Yuusei and is not shy to admit that she is a brocon. She would do anything for him to find true happiness, even if it means sacrificing herself in the process. 

Has a habit of referring people with anything other than their true name, such as younger big brother (to Yuusei), Lunachomu (to Luna), model girl (to Bluette), monastery girl (to Meryl), etc. She refers to herself as "imouto" when talking to both of her brothers.

[spoiler]It is revealed later that Resona is actually talented in fashion design. The reason Aeon said otherwise is that so Resona doesn't get on the way of his ambition.[/spoiler]
